about.title: About Izabela Santos
about.subtitle: Tarot reader, integrative therapist and student of Jungian analytical psychology.

journey.title: My Journey
journey.paragraph1: My passion for tarot began as a personal quest for self-knowledge and transformed into a vocation to help other people on their journeys.
journey.paragraph2: With a degree in Business Administration and specialization in Integrative Natural Therapies, I combined my analytical knowledge with intuitive sensitivity to offer readings that go beyond the superficial.
journey.paragraph3: Currently, I study Jungian Analytical Psychology, integrating archetypes and symbols into my interpretations of the Lenormand cards.

therapeuticTarot.question: What is therapeutic tarot?
therapeuticTarot.answer: Therapeutic tarot is a self-knowledge tool that uses cards for reflection and guidance, not as a prediction of the future, but as a mirror to better understand situations and possibilities.

readingByQuestions.question: How does reading by questions work?
readingByQuestions.answer: You send your questions through the platform. I do the card spread and prepare a detailed interpretation in PDF, which is available in your client area within 48 hours.

experience.question: Do I need experience with tarot?
experience.answer: No! The readings are done in a clear and accessible way. You don't need any prior knowledge about tarot or the Lenormand deck.

recording.question: Are online sessions recorded?
recording.answer: Yes, with your permission, online sessions can be recorded so you can review the guidance later.

validity.question: What is the validity of the reading?
validity.answer: Readings are available in your client area for 1 year after publication.

topics.question: Can I ask questions about any topic?
topics.answer: Readings can cover areas such as professional, relationships, emotional health and personal growth. We avoid questions about physical health, legal matters or third parties.
